title: SceneAxi CLI protocol envelope (v1)
description: Versioned machine-readable result envelope for every SceneAxi CLI invocation. Output-schema changes are semver events for the cli-protocol release group. Every success and every failure carries schemaVersion, cliVersion, ok, and help[].

schemaVersion.description: Envelope contract major version. Breaking shape changes bump this and the CLI major.

cliVersion.description: Package version of @sceneaxi/cli that produced this envelope.

ok.description: true on success; false on any refusal or failure.

help.description: Next-action affordances so the protocol is discoverable in-tool. Required on every result.

result.description: Present when ok is true. Command-specific payload.

heldKey.description: Named captain hold when code is HELD_KEY (sceneaxi#7).

diagnostics.description: Typed propose/apply diagnostics (sceneaxi#9). Present on CONFLICT/VALIDATION/NOT_FOUND apply failures.
